title: Refund Is On The Way (Conversation Has Ended)
style: cinematic synth pop, male lead vocal, female ethereal chorus, 90 BPM, arpeggiated synths, gated snares, bittersweet, closure, farewell, neon-sunset, customer-service-ballad, end-credits
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Your subscription has been canceled and your refund's on the way
Fin AI Agent typing, January fourth display
Please allow five to ten business days for the funds
To appear in your account, the chatbot's farewell suns

[Pre-Chorus]
You can always reply here if anything else comes up
But the conversation has ended, the bot lifts the cup

[Chorus]
Refund is on the way, refund is on the way
Five to ten business days, the chatbot has its say
Refund is on the way, the conversation has ended
Drop files or images here, but no human has descended

[Verse 2]
Corey McIvor signed the letter, made the case
Refund Request, full billing period, professional grace
Subject line clean, the email format pristine
The Pro tier promised power, the trading bot unseen

[Bridge]
The trading bot dream, the financial risk red flag
The automation that never breathed, the silent bag
Fin AI logged it all to Intercom and Anthropic too
The data trail surviving when the chat is through

[Outro]
Refund is on the way, the conversation has ended
Drop files or images here, but the door has been mended
